input.objective: Repair the Unified Quality Gate classification of lazy image readiness without weakening real broken-image, console, or network failure detection.

observed.failureKind: external lazy images remained unresolved after the auditor scrolled through the page

requirements: Write or extend a failing regression test in test/unified-quality-gate.test.js before production changes.
Keep a real broken image and a failed network request as release-blocking failures.
Do not classify an offscreen lazy image as broken solely because it was not requested during the audit.
Do not use a fixed waitForTimeout as the readiness mechanism; use image lifecycle events, decode state, viewport/staged loading evidence, or an explicit indeterminate classification.
Do not modify any file under clientes/flashtech-caso-04-growth/site or its assets.
Return compact before/after evidence and the exact commands executed.
